inputs.checklistItemText: Overhead utility lines (existing and proposed) not shown on applicable sheets (BAS-14a)
inputs.question: Are overhead utility lines (existing or proposed) shown on this sheet? Look for overhead electric lines, utility poles, or symbols indicating overhead utilities in the legend and on the drawing.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking a presence/feature-discovery question: do overhead utility lines appear on this sheet at all? This is a sheet-discovery and feature-presence check, not a drawing-inspection of annotations/symbols or a measurement task. The agent is verifying whether the feature exists on the plan before any detailed inspection of how it is depicted.
